payout_quote: You'll earn a $50 reward for each person who opens a new checking account and they'll receive a $50 bonus as well! ... Earn $50 for each referral when qualifications are met. ... Keep sharing and earning - there's no limit.
steps: Be an existing Andrews Federal Credit Union member with an account in good standing.
Share the Refer-A-Friend offer with friends and family; they must include your name on the referral form.
Your friend joins Andrews Federal (Base Share Savings with $5 opening deposit) and opens any new checking account, gets a VISA Debit Card, and enrolls in online/mobile banking.
Your friend makes three (3) or more purchases with the VISA Debit Card and keeps the new account open for at least 90 days.
You see the $50 referral reward in your account 90 days after your friend completes the required steps; both you and your friend receive $50.
catches: The $50 is credited only 90 days after your friend completes all steps - one of the slowest payouts in this batch.
The friend must be a genuine newcomer: no existing account with Andrews Federal as of 02/02/2022.
If either account is closed or not in good standing before the credit is paid, the referral credit is forfeited.
There is a $25 fee if the friend's account is closed within 60 days of opening.
New accounts must be opened at an Andrews branch (or online with all supporting documents submitted).
Employees, directors, contractors of the CU and their direct family members are ineligible.
The Credit Union reserves the right to change or end the offer at any time.
biggest_catch: You wait a full 90 days after your friend finishes all requirements before the $50 appears - and the friend must be a true newcomer with no account at Andrews since 2022.
eligibility: Existing Andrews Federal Credit Union members in good standing. Referred person must have no existing account with the CU as of 02/02/2022 and be eligible for membership.
timing: Referral reward credited 90 days after the referred friend completes all required steps.
